properties.description: Three tests through rmcp's real call_tool on an in-memory design whose Project records no OWNED_BY. Behind CallerRule::TrustedGateway: _meta reflow2/design_owners [who:bob] with writes_for who:ann → add_decision and replace_text say "question for the owner" (ask_question, no set_decision_status); writes_for who:bob → offered set_decision_status; two owners named → either is offered; the Project still has no OWNED_BY edge. No owners key, or an empty list → the design's record decides (no owner → offered). On CallerRule::Local and on a registry with no gateway (Undeclared) the key is ignored: a named member is offered on a no-owner design, and where OWNED_BY who:bob is recorded the key naming the member does not make them the owner.
properties.findings: At d09ee3830 on ajs77 (rust 1.98.1): 3 passed, a_settling_cue_goes_to_whoever_can_give_the_word 4 passed. With the host's word disabled (named_by_host forced to None) a_named_member_on_a_design_with_no_owned_by_is_told_to_ask_the_owner FAILED and the other two passed, so the test pins the fault. cargo dev-test and the on_disk program together: 3773 passed, 0 failed; clippy -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean. flo2's real-engine test against this build passed 4 of 4 at both doors.
